title: Digests written for feature_compose carry success, duration and cost only, omitting the three fields that carry the diag
description: Digests written for feature_compose carry success, duration and cost only, omitting the three fields that carry the diagnostic signal. Verified live 2026-09-14: every feature_compose row in trace_digest has failure_mode_type, output_impulse_shapes and task_summaries all null, while validator-dispatch (758 rows), slot-binding (153) and ribosome-extract (20) carry failure_mode_type. Reduced fidelity precisely for the activity that matters most for reuse. EDIT_SITE CORRECTED - IT WAS WRONG TWICE OVER. The previous edit_site repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts contains ZERO writes to trace_digest (a true zero). The digest writer is repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts (INSERT INTO trace_digest near line 594), a file INVISIBLE TO GNU GREP because it embeds two raw NUL bytes at lines 4372 and 4600, so grep classifies all 254,962 bytes as binary and suppresses every line match - 'grep -c' prints nothing, not 0, while ripgrep returns 7. That is how this gap acquired its wrong anchor. USE rg IN THIS REPO. ACTIVITY-API IS NOT THE FIX SITE EITHER. execution-traces.ts:585-590 writes the three fields CONDITIONALLY, only when the incoming trace carries them, and that logic is correct and generic - it works for every other activity. Do NOT add compose special-casing there. THE FIX SITE IS THE COMPOSE EMITTER: repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, the POST to /v2/activities/executions at approximately line 6387, whose body sends activity_id, success, duration_ms, cost, tokens, error_message and metadata - and none of the three. CRITICAL - THE THREE FIELDS HAVE DIFFERENT SHAPES, AND GUESSING FLAT NAMES FOR ALL THREE WILL SILENTLY DO NOTHING. Read against execution-traces.ts: (1) failure_mode must be NESTED - the reader is 'const failureModeType = body.failure_mode?.type' at :584, so send failure_mode: { type: ... }. A flat failure_mode_type field is IGNORED. (2) output_impulse_shapes is FLAT - read as trace.output_impulse_shapes at :586. (3) task_summaries is NOT ACCEPTED AS AN INPUT AT ALL - it is DERIVED at :562 from trace.tasks, so the emitter must send a tasks array. Sending task_summaries is ignored. THE DATA IS NOT MISSING, ONLY UNPROJECTED. The compose execution row already carries 23 compose-specific metadata keys that ARE the wanted signal: apply_failed, rolled_back, hard_fail, verify_ok, verify_failed_output, semantic_reason, cutover_refusals, op_count, ops_applied, landed_vessels, touched_vessels, route, gap_id and the examination_* set. Law 8: the load-bearing fact exists and is not where the reader looks. REMEDY: in that POST body add failure_mode: { type: <derived from apply_failed/rolled_back/hard_fail/verify_ok> }, output_impulse_shapes: [<shape produced>], and tasks: [<per-op records behind op_count/ops_applied>]. The specification is above; this failure text is context only and is not the specification.]
